Subject: Performance concerns — proposed redirection plan and next steps

Team,

I need HR and legal input on a formal next step for Rohan Mehta (rohan.mehta@redwood.com). Over the last two performance cycles we've seen repeated missed milestones on the Search feature work and several code freeze regressions. I've had several coaching conversations (notes below) but the pattern persists and product timelines are at risk.

Attached is a first-pass "redirection" plan I drafted — it focuses on clear deliverables, a shortened cadence (4 weeks), and a support plan (mentorship, pairing sessions). Before I send anything to Rohan I want to ensure:

- HR approves the timeline/terms and confirms any accommodations we should consider
- Legal reviews the language around expectations, potential separation wording, and documentation best practices
- Michael signs off on scope/impact and is aware of the escalation

Quick background:
- 2026-07: missed delivery on Search v2 (led to 2-week delay)
- 2026-08: regression introduced in release; rolled back two commits
- Multiple 1:1 coaching sessions (notes in the Drive link below)

I would like to (a) get HR/legal comments today or tomorrow and (b) schedule an alignment call Wed 10/7 10:30am PT to finalize the draft. If HR/legal recommend changes that affect the plan, please flag immediately.

Attachments: draft_redirection_plan_v1.docx (my annotated version)

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa — thanks for the detailed notes and for drafting the plan. I reviewed the draft and attached our HR checklist for performance cases; I also added inline comments in the draft where we should avoid disciplinary language that could be interpreted as punitive. A few immediate items:

- Shortened cadence looks reasonable (4 weeks) but request that we build in weekly documented checkpoints and a final documented review meeting.
- Please confirm whether Rohan has any ongoing accommodation requests (I checked People Ops records and there are none on file). If there are any medical or accommodation flags we need to loop in Employee Experience.
- Recommend including a section on support: assigned mentor, scheduled pairing sessions, and measurable success criteria (deliverables + quality gates).
- Avoid explicit termination timelines; keep wording focused on "improvement expectations" and next steps. Legal will provide suggested language for the final paragraph about next steps if targets are not met.

I can join the Wed 10/7 alignment call. Attaching: hr_checklist_for_performance_cases.pdf and my commented draft (see Drive link).

Laura

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Performance concerns — proposed redirection plan and next steps

Marissa / Laura — I reviewed the draft and added a short redlines doc (legal_suggested_language.docx). High level:

- Use "performance redirection plan" or "performance support plan" rather than acronyms; keep the tone constructive.
- For the consequences section, we should include an escalation path but keep it conditional and stepwise (i.e., additional coaching -> final review -> potential separation) rather than specific hard deadlines.
- Preserve documentation: ensure every checkpoint is logged (we recommend a shared doc with timestamps).
- If you intend to include any comparative statements about peers, avoid specifics that could be construed as discriminatory.
- If you plan to invite an external consultant or union rep (not applicable here), we need to follow additional protocols.

I also flagged two sentences that could be tightened to reduce risk. Happy to hop on the Wed alignment call; if timing works I'd prefer the first 20 minutes for legal quick review.

Aditya Rao
Lead Counsel (Employment Law)
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Subject: Performance support plan: request to meet and next steps

Hi Rohan —

Thanks for your continued efforts on Search; I know this has been a tough quarter. I want to set up a short meeting to discuss a Performance Support Plan so we can align on expectations and create a concrete path forward. This is intended to be collaborative and to make sure you have the support you need.

Proposed: 1:1 on Tue 10/6 2:00pm PT — please confirm or propose an alternate time today.

Summary of concerns (high level):
- Missed delivery targets on Search v2 and ongoing regressions introduced in release cycles.
- Need clearer ownership of deliverables and better test coverage in feature branches.

What to expect if you accept the meeting:
- We will review a short written plan that includes weekly checkpoints and measurable deliverables (4-week time box).
- HR will be copied on the plan and will provide resources for coaching/mentorship if useful.
- If we are not seeing sufficient improvement after the agreed checkpoints, we will have a final review meeting to determine next steps.

Attached: finalized draft of the plan (draft_redirection_plan_v1.docx) with HR/legal comments incorporated.

Please let me know if you want someone else present at the meeting.

-Marissa
